how to slow internet is an artist project centrally focused on experimentation with small scale communication technology in order to better consider the large scale communications infrastructure on which we increasingly depend.

📡 Subscribe to RSS feed to get research and open call updates.

🐌 to slow: a glossary and resource page 👄
